phase_title: Residual Failure Differential Attribution & Hypothesis Formation

pre_change_workspace_manifest.rule: all regular files; exclude path segments {__pycache__, .git, .codebuddy, node_modules, .venv, venv}; exclude top-level dirs {data, .github}; exclude root names {.gitignore, .gitattributes}; exclude *.pyc/*.pyo; pre-change variant additionally excludes all V4.8.2 authorized paths; per-file hash = sha256-path-content-v2-canonical-lf (CRLF/CR -> LF for text suffixes)

remote_verification_method: git ls-remote (read-only); no fetch / no pull

phase_numbering_audit.V4_9_to_V4_13_occurrences: roadmap candidate naming only (docs/V4_MASTER_REQUIREMENTS_AND_ROADMAP.md, docs/V4_7_CLOSURE_GOVERNANCE_ALIGNMENT.md, prior phase artifacts)

forbidden: call local diagnostic model / Ollama / qwen2.5:7b
reconstruct historical request content from current production code

evidence_admissibility_hierarchy.E1: frozen raw request / semantic request object / raw model output / raw output hash / request digest
evidence_admissibility_hierarchy.E2: frozen machine artifact mechanically derived fields
evidence_admissibility_hierarchy.E3: frozen human report statements directly traceable to E1/E2
evidence_admissibility_hierarchy.E4: current production implementation, used only to interpret serialization/mechanics
forbidden: E4 reconstruct missing historical request content
evidence_admissibility_hierarchy.missing_rule: if a feature cannot be mechanically established from E1-E4: FEATURE_VALUE = NOT_AVAILABLE

responsive_reference_role: DIFFERENTIAL_REFERENCE_CASE (not a new experimental control, not a true negative control, not a new primary target)

differential_domains.description: raw query text and mechanically detectable query-structure markers
required number/identity of documents in the frozen Product outcome definition
frozen retrieved chunk structure, document grouping, positions and text-volume distribution
canonical title strings, variants, occurrence counts and positions in the frozen request
how titles bind to chunks / document ids in the frozen serialization
chunk-to-document membership shape (duplication, adjacency); explicit-metadata operationalization already tested in V4.8.1
message roles/count, evidence and instruction placement, character lengths
mechanically tagged properties of frozen raw outputs (parent matcher/normalization reused; no new matcher)
frozen A / B / A+B / G outcome profiles (reused, never rerun)

feature_schema.name: Raw query text
Query character count
Query contains plural document marker 哪些
Query contains singular document marker 哪份
Query contains explicit certainty modifier 明确
Expected document count
Outcome requires more than one document identity
Expected title strings (frozen order)
Retrieved material chunk count
Unique document_id count in retrieved chunks
Group sizes in first-occurrence order
feature_schema.extraction_rule: chunks grouped by document_id; groups ordered by first occurrence in material order; value = chunk count per group

feature_schema.name: Largest same-document chunk group
Document transitions in chunk order
feature_schema.extraction_rule: count of adjacent chunk pairs (i, i+1) whose document_id differs

feature_schema.name: Chunks carrying an expected document identity
feature_schema.extraction_rule: chunk counts as expected iff its document_title contains at least one expected title string as literal substring (same literal substring semantics as the frozen Product title matcher); count of expected chunks

feature_schema.name: Chunks NOT carrying an expected document identity
First chunk is an expected-document chunk
feature_schema.extraction_rule: material_index 1 chunk satisfies the expected-document substring rule

feature_schema.name: Character length of last material text
Total characters of expected-document chunk texts
Total characters of non-expected-document chunk texts
Distinct rendered document_title values in first-occurrence order
feature_schema.extraction_rule: distinct document_title per chunk, first-occurrence order

feature_schema.name: Number of distinct rendered title strings
A rendered title carries a chapter prefix (第1章)
Total occurrences of expected titles in raw user message
feature_schema.extraction_rule: sum over expected titles of non-overlapping-with-advance substring occurrence count in v4_7 final_application_model_request.messages[1].content (scan: find at start, next start = i+1)

feature_schema.name: Character distance from last expected-title occurrence to question line
feature_schema.extraction_rule: content.rfind('问题：') - max(last occurrence index over expected titles)

feature_schema.name: Chunks whose serialized header carries the document title
feature_schema.extraction_rule: count(title_present_in_serialized_header == true) in v4_7 material map

feature_schema.name: Max chunks sharing one expected title (literal substring)
feature_schema.extraction_rule: for each expected title: count chunks whose serialized header location_in_header contains the title as literal substring; take max

feature_schema.name: One rendered title string maps to >=2 distinct document_id
feature_schema.extraction_rule: group chunks by exact document_title; YES iff any title maps to >=2 distinct document_id

feature_schema.name: Chunk duplication ratio 1 - unique/chunks
Adjacent chunk pairs sharing one document_id
feature_schema.extraction_rule: count of adjacent chunk pairs (i, i+1) with equal document_id

feature_schema.name: Model-visible message count
Model-visible role sequence (C0)
Instruction lines in C0 request
B1 naming instruction text as instantiated (C2)
Raw user-message character length
C0: canonical title emitted
C0: generic material identity used
C0: material numbers emitted (unique ascending)
feature_schema.extraction_rule: sorted(set(int(match) for match in re.findall(r'材料(\d+)', per_case.conditions.C0.raw_answer)))

feature_schema.name: C0: document noun 文档 present in answer
C0: coverage of expected documents by emitted material numbers
feature_schema.extraction_rule: map emitted material numbers to document_title via material map; classify expected-document coverage as COMPLETE (all expected), PARTIAL (some expected), NONE (no expected)

feature_schema.name: All tested conditions generic-material-only (O2=YES and O1=NO)
feature_schema.extraction_rule: V4.8 C0-C3 observables and (for residual cases) V4.8.1 G0/G1 observables all have O2 == 'YES' and O1 == 'NO'

feature_schema.name: Any condition answer contains a document-level referent (该文档/这份文档)
feature_schema.extraction_rule: any of ['该文档','这份文档'] in any raw_answer of the case's tested conditions

feature_schema.name: Factor A sensitivity (delta A given B0)
Factor B sensitivity (delta B given A0)
Joint A+B outcome Y(C3)
Factor G sensitivity (V4.8.1 DELTA_G)
feature_schema.extraction_rule: V4.8.1 per_case[case].DELTA_G for residual cases; md-004 = NOT_AVAILABLE (reference pair not required, never run)

differential_pattern_rules.RESPONSIVE_ONLY: canonical(md004) != canonical(md009) AND canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND all three available
differential_pattern_rules.NONRESPONDER_SHARED: canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND canonical(md004) != canonical(md009) AND all three available
differential_pattern_rules.ALL_SAME: canonical(md004) == canonical(md009) == canonical(md015) AND all three available
differential_pattern_rules.MD009_ONLY: canonical(md009) != canonical(md004) AND canonical(md009) != canonical(md015) AND canonical(md004) == canonical(md015)
differential_pattern_rules.MD015_ONLY: canonical(md015) != canonical(md004) AND canonical(md015) != canonical(md009) AND canonical(md004) == canonical(md009)
differential_pattern_rules.NOT_AVAILABLE: at least one case value is NOT_AVAILABLE

feature_canonicalization_rules.string: exact frozen text; no normalization beyond the predeclared value itself
feature_canonicalization_rules.list: kept in frozen order unless the feature is defined as an unordered set (none in this schema); elementwise exact comparison
feature_canonicalization_rules.float: rounded to 4 decimals by the frozen extraction_rule before comparison
feature_canonicalization_rules.missing: NOT_AVAILABLE is never equal to any value, including another NOT_AVAILABLE, for pattern classification; a feature with any NOT_AVAILABLE case value is pattern NOT_AVAILABLE

similarity_rules.comparable_features: features where md-009 and md-015 are both not NOT_AVAILABLE
similarity_rules.interpretation_boundary: mechanical feature similarity only; does not imply same causal mechanism

difference_rules.shared_residual_features: features where md-009 and md-015 have equal available canonical values
difference_rules.denominator: shared residual features where md-004 value is available (not NOT_AVAILABLE)
difference_rules.differential_shared_features: denominator features where canonical(md004_value) != canonical(shared residual value)
difference_rules.interpretation_boundary: descriptive differential strength only; does not automatically support any mechanism

candidate_generation_rule: a candidate hypothesis must originate from one or more mechanically observed differential features in the frozen feature inventory; intuition-only candidates are invalid
previously_tested_hypothesis_rule: these must be tagged PREVIOUSLY_TESTED_OR_CONSTRAINED; any overlapping candidate must state what new factor is actually different, otherwise the candidate is invalid

candidate_support_rules.STRONGLY_SUPPORTED: >= 2 independent differential domains; each domain contains at least one traceable mechanically reliable feature; features consistently differentiate md-004 from BOTH md-009 and md-015; candidate is compatible with prior A/B/G results; no direct frozen evidence contradiction
candidate_support_rules.SUPPORTED: one strong differential domain with multiple internally consistent mechanical features, OR >= 2 weaker independent differential domains; and no direct contradiction from prior intervention results
candidate_support_rules.PLAUSIBLE_ONLY: conceptually coherent but frozen evidence does not materially discriminate it
candidate_support_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: frozen evidence directly contradicts candidate or prior intervention already provides relevant negative evidence
candidate_support_rules.forbidden: PLAUSIBLE_ONLY must not be promoted to NEXT_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS

candidate_ranking_rules.eligible: only STRONGLY_SUPPORTED and SUPPORTED candidates enter the ranked shortlist
order: 2. case coverage: candidate supported by both residual cases > candidate supported by one residual case
5. if still tied: TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS = NOT_UNIQUELY_ESTABLISHED (no manual tie-breaking)
candidate_ranking_rules.tie_rule: ties must not be broken manually

shared_residual_rule: SHARED_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS = YES only if a candidate supports both md-009 and md-015 and is based on NONRESPONDER_SHARED differential evidence; NO if md-009 and md-015 require materially different candidate evidence; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
next_hypothesis_rule: NEXT_RESIDUAL_HYPOTHESIS is emitted only when TOP_CANDIDATE_SUPPORT is SUPPORTED or STRONGLY_SUPPORTED AND TOP_CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS is uniquely established; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED with NEXT_DIAGNOSTIC_GOAL = DISCRIMINATE_TOP_CANDIDATES
direct_title_probe_rule: output DIRECT_TITLE_PROBE_MECHANICALLY_JUSTIFIED = YES/NO/NOT_ESTABLISHED only; execution is forbidden in this phase
future_intervention_boundary: MINIMAL_FUTURE_DIAGNOSTIC_INTERVENTION may be designed but never executed; must satisfy: ONE new factor only, minimal model-visible semantic diff, same frozen evidence where mechanically possible, contemporaneous control, stateless calls, frozen Product outcome, clear hypothesis-discrimination value, no Product mutation, no baseline change, no Full-144
